'''Kala'uun's head-clan''' was a [[Head clan (Ryloth)|head-clan]] that governed the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Kala'uun/Legends|Kala'uun]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]].<ref name="PSG" />

{{Company-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Is the Shak clan still the Head-clan here?|Wedge Antilles|<ref name="The Krytos Trap">''[[X-Wing: The Krytos Trap]]''</ref>}}
The [[1996]] novel ''[[X-Wing: The Krytos Trap]]'' erroneously refers to the [[Clan Shak]] as the Head-clan of Kala'uun.<ref name="The Krytos Trap" />
